sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Hand-painted outlined 2D platformer enemy animation sprite sheet. Reference image is ONLY character identity/style, not pose count/layout. Exactly SIX full-body poses in a precise equal 3-column by 2-row grid on 1536x1024 canvas; 512x512 cells. Chronological reading order. Same camera, scale and identity in every cell, right-facing three-quarter. Subject total height approx 330px, 70px CLEAR transparent padding. Whole cap/body/arms/feet/effects inside each own cell with no overlap. Opaque subject interior, genuine transparent background, no floor, shadow, colored haze, text, labels, borders, scenery or other creatures. Do not copy reference layout. Same Sporeling red spotted cap, ivory/moss small root body. Six hurt reaction phases: ready, sudden wince eyes squeezed cap jerks backward left, deep recoil leaning left, brace lowered root body, begin rise, recover. No attack and no particles, nonviolent magical damage reaction. Use compact sprites with margins, no background effects.
